predicate.semantics: nodeType = type(node).__name__ for the AST node currently visited by the recursive ExpressionEvaluator. The branch is taken iff that node is a Python ast.Call (function-call syntax such as foo(a, b) or abs(x)).

encoding.approach: Harvested op-surface at this dispatch is a single equality compare over an enum string (nodeType). The seeded domain restricts nodeType to {Call, Compare}. Encoded nodeType as a Z3 EnumSort over those two values and the predicate as (nodeType == Call). Z3 returned sat for both the predicate and its negation within the seeded enum: branch is neither tautology nor contradiction over the harvested surface.
encoding.domain_note: nodeType is not itself a CLI/YAML/int/bool public input. It is derived at runtime via type(node).__name__ from ast.parse(expressionStr). The genuine free variable upstream is expressionStr (a hard-coded literal in all production call sites). The Z3 model is sat over the harvested enum surface, but the real determinant is a parsed-tree node type, so classification stays runtime-dependent.

true_examples.derivation: ast.parse('abs(x)', mode='exec').body[0].value is an ast.Call -> type(node).__name__ == 'Call' -> predicate True.
true_examples.verified: Confirmed in-container: ast top-value nodeType == 'Call'. ExpressionEvaluator().evaluate(ast.parse('abs(x)'), {'x': -7}) actually enters the Call branch (reaches line 688 createUnaryOp) before asserting on the unmapped 'abs' operator -- proving the line-673 dispatch is taken.

false_examples.derivation: ast.parse('BenchmarkTaskSize > 0', mode='exec').body[0].value is an ast.Compare -> type(node).__name__ == 'Compare' != 'Call' -> predicate False (Compare branch at line 657 taken instead).
false_examples.verified: Confirmed in-container: walk node types {Compare, Constant, Expr, Gt, Load, Module, Name}, no Call node. This is one of the two real production addConstraint() call-site strings (TensileBenchmarkCluster.py:283).

pure_helper:
def is_call_branch(nodeType: str) -> bool:
    """
    Pure mirror of Configuration.py:673  elif nodeType == "Call":
    nodeType is type(node).__name__ for the visited AST node.

    pre: nodeType in ("Call", "Compare")
    post: __return__ == (nodeType == "Call")
    """
    return nodeType == "Call"
pure_helper_note: CrossHair 0.0.106 'check --per_condition_timeout=20' found NO counterexample to the post-condition (exit 0, no output) over the seeded enum precondition. Per task guidance: absence of a CrossHair counterexample is NOT a proof of correctness, only that none was found within the search budget. The helper isolates the decidable equality; it deliberately does NOT model the runtime-dependent ast.parse + type().__name__ derivation that produces nodeType.

reachability.production: DEAD in production: no current addConstraint() call site passes a string containing a function-call sub-expression. Both production strings parse to Compare/BoolOp, never Call.
reachability.tests: Reachable in unit tests by passing a call-expression string (e.g. abs(x), len(a)). Verified the dispatch is entered.

notes: Branch predicate is a runtime AST-node-type dispatch (type(node).__name__ == 'Call'). Not a function of any CLI/YAML/int/bool public input directly; nodeType is derived at runtime from parsing expressionStr. Over the harvested enum op-surface {Call, Compare} the decision is a clean equality and Z3 returned sat for both the True witness (nodeType=Call, expr 'abs(x)') and the False witness (nodeType=Compare, expr 'BenchmarkTaskSize > 0'). Both witnesses are additionally empirically grounded by running ast.parse and the real ExpressionEvaluator in-container. Classification = runtime-dependent because the true determinant is a live parsed-tree node type; solver_status = sat reflects the genuine Z3 result over the harvested enum surface, with value-grounded witnesses supplied so downstream can pin behavior.
